scope: The two cars Qazi asked about · Nashville, TN
title: What These Two Cars Have Been Through
lead: Two 2022 296 GTBs in Rosso Corsa at Prancing Horse of Nashville. Both CARFAX reports and window stickers read line by line; priced against 9 BaT sales and 12 live dealer asks.
takeaway: My two cents: the 2,862-mile car is the one. Both ask about $330k; BaT has been selling 2022 to 2023 GTBs for $267k to $288k all year. Open the 2.9k car at $318k, land $300k, walk above $305k. Ferrari of Tampa Bay asks $309,985 for a 3k-mile 2023; use it. Neither car shows a service since 2023 or 2024, so the service printout comes first.
shift: BaT, Jun 23, 2026 (+5% buyer fee, capped $7,500). Closest match to the 5.3k car
BaT, Jul 20, 2026; newest 2022 to 2023 GTB sale
9 BaT sales of 2022 to 2023 GTBs this year
$267,777 to $327,000, median $275,000 (about $282,500 with the fee). Only the $161k-option matte car and an Assetto Fiorano cleared $300k
Ferrari of Tampa Bay 3k $309,985; Sport Cars Lux 2k $319,990; Ferrari of SF 6k $327,864; Greensboro 6k $329,950; Napleton 5k $330,412; Fort Lauderdale 2k $345,000 (classic.com, Nov 15)

Both cars were delivered new by this store, listed here Sep 27, 2024, sold in 2025 and came back. Neither shows an annual service since 2023 (2.9k) or Apr 2024 (5.3k). The 5.3k car had brakes done at 3,100 mi
sources: Dealer listings, window stickers (dealer Window Sticker button) and free CARFAX reports (ar20 links) read in full in Walt Chrome, Nov 15, 2026. Ferrari Approved page for the 2.9k car. Days listed from the dealer's own in-stock dates (Oct 12 and Nov 7). Sold prices from Bring a Trailer; live asks and market average from classic.com, Nov 15. Reviews: Google (610 of 734, newest first), Yelp, DealerRater, Cars.com, BBB, CarEdge. Staff from phofnash.com/about-us/staff. Nobody contacted.

cars.verdict: $24,995 over the $305k cap at $329,995. Open $318k, target $300k, walk above $305k. The better of the two: lowest miles, carbon Corsa seats, ceramic tips, PPF, $412,547 sticker, and 34 days on the lot. The knock: no service reported since Jun 2023. Before money, ask for the Ferrari service printout and the Ferrari Approved inspection, and why it came back.

cars.verdict: $20,995 over the $305k cap at $325,995. Open $314k, target $295k, walk above $300k. BaT sold a 6k-mile Rosso Corsa / Nero 2022 for $275,000 in June. Brakes at 3,100 miles is the question: the 296's rotors are carbon ceramic, so that means track days or a warranty fix. Get the April 2024 repair order before anything else. Only 8 days listed, so less bend than the 2.9k car.
